Frontend verified end-to-end: (a) /kiosk/demo renders Margaret / Room 101 idle screen with 'CALL FOR HELP' red button + YOUR ROOM grid showing Bedside lamp / Ceiling fan / Heater / TV tiles and tile-tap toggles state (b) Admin → Tasks tab shows Today(10) + Templates(10) sub-tabs with add-task-btn + Spawn today's tasks + PENDING/COMPLETED rows for breakfast/meds/laundry/rounds/bathing/activity (c) Admin → Smart devices tab lists 8 seeded devices (Room 101/108, protocols bluetooth/wifi/rf_915/ir) with On/Off/brightness/temp buttons + add-device-btn (d) Admin → Kiosks shows CENTRAL red badge on Central Nurse Station row; add-kiosk dialog contains kiosk-central-toggle (e) /staff as nurse Sarah shows my-tasks-card ('My tasks today · 1 OPEN · 1 DONE') with Start + Complete buttons and Complete opens a dialog.

issues: DialogContent overlay renders the New-kiosk form visually stacked on top of the underlying Wall-kiosks table — form fields are readable but the table text bleeds through because the dialog background alpha is low. Consider bumping dialog bg to solid or increasing backdrop opacity.

action_items: (Optional) Increase Admin kiosk-dialog background opacity so the underlying table doesn't show through the New-kiosk form.
(Optional) The Kiosk idle 'YOUR ROOM' grid wraps TV onto a second row by itself on 1920-wide layouts — consider 4-col grid at lg breakpoint so TV stays next to Heater.
(Optional) Tasks tab — no filter chip for shift (day/evening/night/any); admin must scan the whole list. Minor UX polish.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tasks.py list_tasks — the 'day' filter uses created_at comparison against ISO strings which works only because created_at is stored as +00:00 ISO; a task created with a different TZ offset or stored as BSON Date would silently fall outside the range. Consider using actual datetime comparison with $gte/$lte + tz normalization.

routes/tasks.py complete_task accepts arbitrary 'body: dict' without Pydantic model — no validation on 'notes' length or type. Swap for a CompleteTaskInput(notes: Optional[str] = None) model for input safety and docs.

routes/pendants.py panic-press window: window_start uses ISO string comparison on created_at which again relies on all records being +00:00 ISO. Safe today but brittle. Also, press_count math counts ALL alerts in the last 60s for this pendant regardless of severity — a stale 'fall' alert would bump the count. Filter by triggered_by='pendant' AND event_type='press' (you'd need to persist event_type on Alert doc).

routes/kiosks.py active-emergency — returns the whole alert doc to an UNAUTHENTICATED endpoint, including resident_id + resident_name + zone. Acceptable for a wall kiosk but worth noting in the public API spec; any leaked kiosk_id lets a caller poll for resident PII.

routes/devices.py public_room_command has no rate-limit or HMAC enforcement by default (DEVICE_AUTH_REQUIRED=false). A rogue client on the same network could mass-toggle every light in every room. For production, at minimum enforce HMAC on the public device endpoints and/or keep the kiosk tablet on a separate VLAN.

routes/tasks.py spawn-today — loops with an inline 'await db.staff_tasks.find_one' per template. For >100 active templates this is O(N) round-trips; bulk-fetch today's existing template_ids once then diff.

Admin.jsx now has 10+ tabs (Residents, Pendants, Wearables, Smart devices, Tasks, Staff, Kiosks, Zones, Family, Device tokens, Insights, Roadmap). Consider collapsing into groups (Care / Devices / Ops / System) to reduce cognitive load — 12 tabs is past typical Radix TabsList capacity on <1440px widths.
